about: step-plan rewrites a requirement the send-back it answers names (step-plan-rewrite-design.md, The change, items 1 and 2). Generated by make_overlay.py from wording/*.txt: edit those, not this.

edits.old:
in KNOWLEDGE/, unless an owner note this stage owes asks for a requirement change: then rewrite that requirement in
    place in KNOWLEDGE/spec.md (the ID stays; its entry keeps no copy of the old clause) and plan the step for the
    rewritten text.
edits.new:
in KNOWLEDGE/, unless an owner note this stage owes, or the send-back this plan answers, asks for a requirement
    change: then rewrite that requirement in place in KNOWLEDGE/spec.md (the ID stays; its entry keeps no copy of the
    old clause) and plan the step for the rewritten text. A rewrite a send-back asks for keeps every clause the
    send-back does not name, relaxes none to fit code or tests already written, says in the entry that step-plan revised
    it and why, and is named in `summary`.

edits.old: Add lines only; a requirement whose intent moved is no edit: report send-back naming the R-<n>.
edits.new:
Add lines only; a requirement whose intent moved is no edit: report send-back naming the R-<n> and what it must
     say.
